scope: integrate + verify the public prose pages batch (/activities, /activity/:id, /members, /history, /logs)

scoped_unit.command: cd web && ../node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/public-pages.test.ts tests/public-render.test.ts tests/public-clipboard.test.ts tests/public-markdown-highlight.test.ts tests/public-markdown-server.test.ts tests/public-members-sort.test.ts

first_attempt.cause: another workstream's incomplete guest BFF routes (documented in docs/revamp/logs/03-events-guest/README.md)

second_attempt.cause: this batch's relative imports of web/shared, fixed in 3f

typecheck.nuxt_typecheck: not run here (lead-owned); the lead reported 9 call-site errors and 2 assignment errors, all fixed in 3g

standalone_probe.command: node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --skipLibCheck --target es2022 --lib es2022,dom --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler web/shared/markdown.ts web/app/utils/public-query.ts .tools/tmp/query-value-probe.ts
standalone_probe.covers: both fixed modules compile, and the widened QueryValue accepts vue-router's `LocationQueryValue | LocationQueryValue[] | undefined` at all six entry points with no cast
standalone_probe.does_not_cover: the .vue call sites (logs.vue / members.vue / activities.vue), which need the Nuxt context

authoritative_run.runner_exit: non-zero: DECLARED_SKIP_POLICY is empty and both skips are undeclared

skips.test: code block copy > reports the real outcome for a denied clipboard and for a working one
skips.reason: self-skip: the deterministic fixture activity has no fenced code block, so `.md-code` cannot be observed; the fixture belongs to the data workstream. The clipboard outcomes are covered by tests/public-clipboard.test.ts (6 passing).

fixes_applied_after_the_first_run: support/public-pages.ts: readFile imported from node:fs (callback API) -> node:fs/promises
spec: member assertions scoped to the page body (the layout footer renders 'Designed by Taropoi', which broke 5 assertions)
spec: SSR member assertions scoped to the <main> slice via mainOf(html)
spec: typography expectations rounded (16.8 * 1.5 is 25.200000000000003 in binary float, '25.2px' in the DOM)
spec: the members chart is asserted on /members, not on /members?school=不存在学院, where neither page renders it

measurements: /logs table (light, desktop+mobile): 4010 differing pixels; mobile also fails rect parity (width differs)
visual_parity.note: genuine layout differences; the fixture, theme, timezone and reduced-motion setting are identical on both sides, and the nine replaced environment icons are served as the same bytes to the archived page, so they do not explain the deltas

members_chart_desktop.test: server-rendered public lists > members school filtering is encoded in the URL and isolated (desktop only, deterministic - failed twice)
members_chart_desktop.symptom: svg[role='img'] is found and its aria-label matches, but its first `circle` is not found; a curl of the SSR HTML for /members shows exactly one role=img element and two <circle> seat marks

mobile_navigation_timeout.test: filter and page reactivity > member school navigation updates the body and the canonical URL (mobile only)
mobile_navigation_timeout.symptom: Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded during the client-side filter -> all -> other navigation

invalid_run_kept_as_record.why_invalid: 8 workers against one production server saturates nuxt-security's rate limiter (the pattern the lead flagged); every conclusion above comes from the isolated runner

shared_alias_fix: reason: web/shared sits outside Vite's app root, so a relative import is emitted into the Nitro chunk as an unresolvable path
type_fixes: web/app/utils/public-query.ts: QueryValue widened to 'string | null | undefined | (string | null)[]' to match vue-router 5's route.query value type; type-only, runtime validation unchanged, no call-site casts
web/shared/markdown.ts: SafeCheckboxProps changed from an interface to an object type alias so it has an implicit index signature and satisfies SafeMarkdownProps
implementation_bug_fixes: web/shared/markdown.ts: an whose src is rejected is now dropped instead of emitted as an attribute-less element
web/app/utils/public-query.ts: parsePageParam accepts leading zeros (?page=02 -> 2); 0, negatives, fractions, exponents and non-digits still return null
test_corrections: tests/public-markdown-highlight.test.ts: assert flattened text, not a substring of the serialized tree (Shiki splits the source across one span per token)
tests/public-pages.test.ts: isSafeMarkdownTag('input') is false post-P4 (the closed checkbox branch handles input)
tests/public-pages.test.ts: environmentIconUrl('Android','device') -> generic-device-64748b.svg (the archived deviceIconList has no android keyword)
tests/public-pages.test.ts: the 'never emits an external icon' test asserts a same-origin /icons/env/*.svg path instead of null
tests/public-render.test.ts: a refused tag serializes as '<!---->' (Vue's null placeholder), not ''
lint_fixes: 3 control-character regexes replaced by an equivalent code-point predicate (no eslint-disable needed)
27 vue/html-self-closing + 1 vue/attributes-order warnings fixed with scoped eslint --fix on the five page templates
changes_after_copy.e2e_wiring_fix: tests/e2e/support/public-pages.ts derives ARCHIVE_ORIGIN/FIXTURE_ORIGIN from E2E_PORT_BASE (portBase+2074 / portBase+81) instead of hardcoding 5174/3181

open_deviations: 18 visual-parity failures are undiagnosed real layout/pixel differences against the archived SPA; the page geometry is measurably different (activity article 38.9px shorter, history timeline 3.5px shorter) and several regions differ by thousands of pixels
one deterministic desktop-only failure: the members chart's seat circles are present in SSR but not found in the desktop client
one mobile-only 30s timeout during client-side member filter navigation
the code-block copy E2E test self-skips (no fenced block in the fixture) and the isolated runner's skip policy is empty, so the run exits non-zero
parsePageParam accepts leading zeros - a judgement call; the alternative reading is that ?page=02 stays a 400
the drop changes security-relevant sanitizer code (narrow, covered by a new positive assertion)
highlight colours are github-light only; the archived preview used md-editor-v3 themes
nine archived icon URLs are dead upstream and use locally authored generic marks - a functional replacement, not the archived artwork
two SEO helpers coexist (web/app/composables/usePublicPageSeo.ts and the primary web/app/composables/usePublicSeo.ts); SITE_NAME/DEFAULT_DESCRIPTION are duplicated

three test files still import the shared directory relatively (tests/public-pages.test.ts, tests/public-render.test.ts, tests/public-markdown-server.test.ts); not build offenders, left out of the lead's five-file scope
the page-level type fixes (.vue call sites) are verified only by a standalone probe, not by nuxt typecheck
